message.content:
## Recent developments
* **DOJ Antitrust Inquiries:** In late October 2026, the U.S. Department of Justice initiated inquiries regarding Nvidia Corporation's proposed $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. Regulators are examining how the deal might alter AI competition and affect control over a primary model distribution channel.
* **Leadership & Strategy:** CEO Clem Delangue has publicly reaffirmed the company's commitment to open-source AI amidst shifting industry dynamics and scrutiny following Nvidia's leadership movements and acquisition plans. 
* **ProtoStar Initiative Launch:** Hugging Face partnered with universities (via the Open Forum for AI) to launch "ProtoStar," an open-science initiative designed to integrate public university research with AI. Its inaugural challenge—focused on climate risk intelligence—is being hosted by Carnegie Mellon University in November 2026.
* **Platform Growth:** Hugging Face reported strong momentum in open science, noting that researchers shared more than three times as many new science datasets on the hub in the first nine months of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025.

## Talking points
* Discuss the status of the Nvidia acquisition and how both companies plan to address ongoing Department of Justice competition inquiries.
* Explore the long-term vision for maintaining Hugging Face's neutrality and open-source ethos if the acquisition proceeds.
* Review the early traction of the ProtoStar open-science initiative and opportunities for deeper university or enterprise partnerships.
* Address platform ecosystem health, specifically the growth in documented science datasets and developer engagement.

## Open questions
* What is the anticipated timeline for the DOJ review process regarding the Nvidia transaction?
* How will Hugging Face ensure that its repository remains open and non-discriminatory to competing hardware and software ecosystems?
* What are the next milestones for the ProtoStar initiative following the CMU climate challenge?

## Sources
* [Nvidia + Hugging Face: 5 DOJ Probe Risks [2026]](https://shattered.io/nvidia-hugging-face-doj-inquiry-12-93b-meta-becerra-pac-2026)
* [Hugging Face cofounder: Open-weight AI models were 'our savior'](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/hugging-face-cofounder-open-weight-ai-models-were-our-savior-220000916.html)
* [Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/hugging-face-ceo-vows-to-keep-fighting-for-open-source-ai-after-jensen-huangs-exit)
* [Hugging Face launches ProtoStar open science and AI initiative | ETIH EdTech News — EdTech Innovation Hub](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/hugging-face-and-universities-launch-protostar-to-put-public-research-to-work-with-ai)
* [CMU to Host Challenge to Put Scientific Data to Work With AI - News - Carnegie Mellon University](https://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2026/october/cmu-to-host-challenge-to-put-scientific-data-to-work-with-ai)
